name: Total Variation Margin 1
definition: Margin required to cover the risk because of the price fluctuations occurred on the unsettled exposures towards the central counterparty.

ShortLongIndicator.name: Short Long Indicator
ShortLongIndicator.definition: Specifies whether the variation margin position is short or long, that is, wether the balance is a negative or positive balance.

AmountDetails.name: Amount Details
AmountDetails.definition: Provides the variation margin amount in the reporting currency and optionally in the original currency.
